# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m warden.docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting is stored per server. Change one with `/config set key:<key> value:<value>`,
see current values with `/config view`, and restore a default with `/config reset`.

## Automod

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `automod.badwords` | comma-separated list | *empty* | Blocked words or phrases, comma-separated. Also see /automod words. |
| `automod.badwords_enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Delete messages containing a blocked word. |
| `automod.ban_at` | number (0–100) | `7` | Strikes before a ban (0 = never). |
| `automod.block_invites` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Delete Discord server invites. |
| `automod.enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Master switch for every automod rule. |
| `automod.exempt_role` | @role | *not set* | Members with this role skip automod. Members with Manage Messages always do. |
| `automod.kick_at` | number (0–100) | `5` | Strikes before a kick (0 = never). |
| `automod.link_allowlist` | comma-separated list | `tenor.com, giphy.com` | Domains allowed when the link filter is on, comma-separated. |
| `automod.links_enabled` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Delete messages with links not on the allowlist. |
| `automod.max_mentions` | number (0–100) | `5` | Most users/roles one message may ping (0 = no limit). |
| `automod.raid_joins` | number (0–500) | `10` | Joins that switch raid mode on automatically (0 = never)... |
| `automod.raid_mode` | `true` / `false` | `false` | While on, new members are kicked on join. Use /automod raid. |
| `automod.raid_seconds` | number (1–600) | `10` | ...within this many seconds. |
| `automod.spam_enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Strike members who send messages too quickly. |
| `automod.spam_messages` | number (2–50) | `6` | Messages that count as spam... |
| `automod.spam_seconds` | number (1–120) | `5` | ...within this many seconds. |
| `automod.strike_window_days` | number (0–3650) | `30` | Only warnings from the last N days count as strikes (0 = all time). |
| `automod.timeout_at` | number (0–100) | `3` | Strikes before a timeout (0 = never). |
| `automod.timeout_minutes` | number (1–40320) | `60` | Length of an automatic timeout. |

## Leveling

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `leveling.announce` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Post a message when someone levels up. |
| `leveling.announce_channel` | #channel | *not set* | Where level-ups are posted (not set = the channel they chatted in). |
| `leveling.cooldown_seconds` | number (0–3600) | `60` | Seconds before the same member can earn XP again. |
| `leveling.enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Members earn XP for chatting. |
| `leveling.ignored_channels` | comma-separated list | *empty* | Channels where no XP is earned: #mentions or IDs, comma-separated. |
| `leveling.levelup_message` | text | `GG {mention}, you reached **level {level}**!` | Level-up text. Placeholders: {mention} {user} {level} {server}. |
| `leveling.xp_max` | number (0–1000) | `25` | Most XP one message can earn. |
| `leveling.xp_min` | number (0–1000) | `15` | Least XP one message can earn. |

## Moderation

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `moderation.dm_members` | `true` / `false` | `true` | DM members when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned. |
| `moderation.require_reason` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Reject moderation commands that don't include a reason. |

## Modlog

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modlog.channel` | #channel | *not set* | Channel where every moderation action is logged. |

## Onboarding

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onboarding.dm_enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Also DM new members. If their DMs are closed, the DM text is added to the channel message. |
| `onboarding.dm_message` | text | `Hi {user}, welcome to **{server}**! Read the rules and press **I agree** to get access.` | Text of the welcome DM. Same placeholders. |
| `onboarding.join_role` | @role | *not set* | Role given to everyone who joins. |
| `onboarding.verified_role` | @role | *not set* | Role given when a member presses I agree on the rules. |
| `onboarding.welcome_channel` | #channel | *not set* | Channel for welcome messages. |
| `onboarding.welcome_message` | text | `Welcome to **{server}**, {mention}! You're member #{count}.` | Welcome text in the channel. Placeholders: {mention} {user} {server} {count}. Use \n for a new line. |

## Perks

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `perks.stack` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Keep lower-level reward roles after earning a higher one. |
